comment: Instruction-level patches applied by the recompiler (tools/lib/codegen.mjs). Each one reads a runtime variable from runtime/src/recomp_rt.h; the variables default to values that reproduce the original instruction exactly. Streets of Rage has none yet: each is empty until the game's own spot is found.

sorHit.comment: Where a hit takes health off its target (a0, +$32); the attacker is a1. "d0" for sub.w d0,$32(a0), "#2" for subq.w #2,$32(a0).

sorCull.comment: Streets of Rage sprite pieces: sub_00B0FE keeps a piece whose X (hardware, +$80) is in [$60, $1E0); widescreen widens it.

sorWide.comment: Streets of Rage edges, widened by the widescreen width: the players' clamp (screen 32-288), where enemies walk in (328, -8), the wake test of an enemy waiting off screen (screen X + $80 in $70-$1D0, i.e. -16 to 336), and the game's check of its enemies (sub_000810, which resets the game on a bad one) accepting one still being set up (+$E = 0). Waves from the level table stay where the level puts them: the table also places scenery (the shutters) and enemies waiting in doorways. (Widening the other in-view and on-screen tests as well left waves that never ended.)
